uses: Device Reference operational identity and direct RFC/SR context
staged/reviewed import pipeline and workbook observation model

provides: optional Device Reference resolution and physical Network Element/component context
trackable-domain context only where Communications contracts explicitly allow it; Infrastructure itself is not a communication identity source
Infrastructure workspace data, placement/containment views and deliberate Device Reference regularization actions
device-secret prohibition and future opaque-provider boundary
relationship correction/history requirements for placement, containment, Cloud and component instances

forbidden_dependencies: No Infrastructure command may infer ticket lifecycle, RFC Customer, Task execution, Inventory return state or Communication identity.
No Network Element identity may be derived from descriptive model/serial/IP/placement/Cloud values.
No Rack or Cloud Deployment relation may cross the Network Element's authoritative Site.
No model compatibility record may substitute for an installed Component instance/history record.
No Infrastructure import may mutate domain state before reviewed acceptance through HLD-05/HLD-09 boundaries.
No Beta 1.0 feature may persist device secrets or create canonical connectivity/topology state.
transaction_boundary: Infrastructure mutations revalidate identity, Site consistency, cycle/cardinality constraints and revision state, then commit authoritative relationships plus required audit atomically. Workbook parsing/discovery, matching, UI review and expensive reconciliation occur outside the write transaction.
